reviews.summary: For a phone reader choosing tonight, the same-column tables, the plain Ethos weak points, the picks by need and 'Five things to check before you pay' make it the page to send a friend over anything on page one.

The only page that checks nine digital gift sites on price, free tier, link lifespan, timed opening, voice, lock and languages from each maker's own pages on a stated date, every cell traceable to those pages, saying plainly where another site is the better pick.

Page one is gift-card roundups, e-card listicles and vendor pages; this is a dated, sourced nine-site comparison on link life, set opening time, voice, languages and app needs that says when another site is the better pick.
